title: Chapter 319
text:
The space inside the spaceship was limited, so he could not wear the 'Bat Wings' aircraft. Instead, he used the Electromagnetic Hover-boots and Mini Jet Maneuvers and sprinted toward the main control room. His gliding speed was much faster than stepping on a banana peel.

Han Xiao was very experienced. He knew that the main control room was extremely important. In order to provide support in time, he moved at full speed. Kerlodd and the others were left behind, so he did not have time to care about them.

While he was traveling alone, he was analyzing the enemy's strength in his mind.

Short Horn Star has not been taken down after so long, so there must be no Grade B Supers among the scavengers. Otherwise, the spaceship would have changed owners long ago. The strongest enemy is at most Grade C or C +. With my equipment and templates, the chances of me being on par with the enemy are very high. However, the enemy must have many subordinates. The standard weapons in the galaxy are all different, so their attack power should not be too low. It will be dangerous if they focus fire on me.

Han Xiao was calm as he listed all the factors that could affect the situation in his mind. He knew his own strength very well and would not be arrogant. He would not blindly overestimate the enemy.

Although there were many Supers in the galaxy, high-level combatants were not everywhere. Most of them were still at Grade E and D, and those who had just entered were all youngsters who still needed to grow up.

From Grade C onwards, one would have a well-formed combat power. In the Shattered Star Ring, Grade C Supers were the backbone, Grade B Supers were the rarer high-end power, and Grade A Supers were the rarer Calamity Grade Supers. The differences between the three were very clear. Grade C Supers had decent individual combat power and could fight against a small army on the ground. Grade B Supers had the ability to destroy cities, and their stamina was greatly increased. They could also be used as a single soldier to flatten a spaceship. Grade A Supers were the Calamity Grade Supers, and they could cause natural disasters on the surface of a planet. Some of their powerful abilities could even destroy the surface of a planet … Of course, this would take some time.

…

The sound of the collision echoed in the tunnel, and the aftershock made the metal walls tremble.

The green light collided with the war hammer again, and the two of them took a big step back.

Chi!

A gust of hot air blew out of Lerden's back, releasing the pressure from the mechanical body. He breathed heavily, and his face was covered in sweat. His already pale face became even paler.

Esper abilities required energy, and the mechanical prosthetic body did not produce energy. Lerden's Esper ability did not last very long. The mechanical prosthetic gave him a plethora of combat weapons, and his body was tougher, so he would not die so easily. However, it also came with a price. He would not last long and would wither very quickly.

At this time, the mechanical prosthetic body was damaged everywhere, emitting electric sparks. Serpent Braid was very fierce and strong, but Lerden was confident that he would not lose to him. However, the most troublesome thing was that this was not a one-on-one battle. Hundreds of scavengers were hiding and shooting at him secretly. He had to pay attention to stray bullets at all times, so he wasted a lot of energy to create an energy shield. His attention was also diverted, and many of his injuries were caused by the other scavengers' sneak attacks.

At the end of the tunnel behind Lerden was the door of the main control room. Once he left, the main control room would be in danger, which greatly restricted his actions. He did not dare to go around Serpent Braid to deal with the scavengers first.

The door of the main control room was tightly shut, and the situation outside was transmitted to the monitor. Everyone in the main control room was on tenterhooks. The captain's palms were sweaty, and he pressed hard on the table. He murmured, "We will reach the warning zone in twelve minutes. You have to hang in there!"

Intense gunshots sounded again. Lerden could only create a light shield to protect himself. Serpent Braid laughed viciously, and without giving Lerden a chance to breathe, he pounced again and smashed down with his war hammer.

Lerden's eyes were bloodshot, and his expression was cold. He held on with all his might, but the green light shield was dimming at a speed visible to the naked eye.

Suddenly, the light shield shattered, and the war hammer hit the left side of Lerden's body without any resistance.

Dong!

Half of Lerden's body exploded, and parts flew everywhere like a blooming flower, hitting the wall and spilling oil all over the floor!

Lerden flew out and crashed into the wall, but there was no pain on his face. He was a semi-artificial body, and a broken mechanical body did not feel pain. This artificial body technology was more mature than the Germinal Organization's half-baked technology, and of course, it would not harm his life.

Flames suddenly spewed out from the soles of his feet, and he flew up, leaped over Serpent Braid, and fled the battlefield without hesitation.

The reward was the reason he helped, but Lerden valued his life more. With half of his body broken and the situation critical, he immediately fled without hesitation. He was so rational that he was indifferent.

This spaceship will definitely be lost. No matter what the scavengers want to do, I am not their target. We should not be far from the warning zone now. As long as I get on the emergency aircraft, I will be able to escape. The scavengers will not chase after me.

Seeing Lerden turn around and flee, the captain's body suddenly turned soft. He sat down on the chair and closed his eyes in pain.

It's over. It's all f * cking over.

The Green Knight had been beaten away, and the enemy was so close to the main control room. What hope was there?

Serpent Braid suppressed his desire to chase after them. Remembering the main mission, he waved his hand and led them to the main control room door.

Panic and bewilderment filled the air. Everyone was terrified. With every step the scavenger took forward, the captain's heart sank.

This situation was already hopeless. The captain could not think of any way to turn the situation around. He could not help but think of his wife, child, and mistress back home. He could not help but feel sad.

Just as Serpent Braid was about to smash open the door, he suddenly heard a boom. A surge of heat quickly approached from behind. He hurriedly turned around, and a thick beam of hot light was rapidly expanding in his sight.

Serpent Braid hurriedly raised his war hammer in front of him, and the flames condensed into an invisible force field.

The beam of light hit the target!

Bang!

The war hammer instantly turned into a burning red soldering iron. Serpent Braid screamed, and the war hammer fell out of his hand. His arms and chest glowed like embers, and they were still burning.

"What?" The captain's expression suddenly changed.

At the other end of the passage, Han Xiao was holding a strange golden gun. White smoke was still rising from the muzzle.

The Wrath of Garrett's interface attack was 513 damage, Flaming Will was 2.7 times, Ambush Critical Hit was 2 times, and [Hold Your Breath, Aim] increased shooting power by 30%!

After the defense reduction, this shot had dealt 2,124 damage!

"Too bad it didn't trigger Fatal True Damage." Han Xiao glanced at the scene and raised his eyebrows. "Looks like I arrived in time."

Serpent Braid struggled to get up, picked up the war hammer, and let it burn his hand. He stared at Han Xiao. "Another one! Kill him! "

The other scavengers turned around and focused their fire. Bullets and beams covered the narrow passage, and there was no way to dodge. Han Xiaoxin summoned the Hovering Shield Shuttle and formed an electromagnetic shield in front of him, which rippled under the rain of bullets.

Serpent Braid swung the war hammer, but he did not attack Han Xiao. Instead, he turned around and smashed the door of the main control room.

With a boom, the door fell, and the main control room was exposed. The people inside hurriedly backed away from the door. The captain knocked into a chair and fell to the ground. He looked up at the tall Serpent Braid with a face full of fear.

Just as Serpent Braid was about to enter the main control room, a dark red stream of light lit up between Han Xiao's eyebrows. A female figure with a seductive figure appeared behind him. Her slightly curly red hair danced like seaweed.

[Character Summon Card: Hella]!

Without hesitation, Han Xiao threw all three Psychic Shock at Serpent Braid. Han Technician had just seen the combat information. Serpent Braid was also Level 70, a Pugilist. The Rock Giant bloodline gave him high physical resistance and high HP. Correspondingly, his Psychic Resistance was his weakness.

Serpent Braid's figure froze. The next second, thick blood spurted out from his mouth and nose. He felt as if his brain had exploded. The world was spinning, and he lost control of his body. He fell to the ground in front of the main control room and could not get up.

Han Xiao took large strides and charged past the scavengers. His biochemical muscles bulged, and he grabbed Serpent Braid's braid, swung him to the other side, and smashed a huge hole in the ground.

Their positions were switched. Now, it was Han Xiao blocking the door.

This series of actions resolved the crisis in the main control room. The captain felt as if he had just walked one round on the edge of life and death. He gulped and stuttered, "You're a passenger too?"

In his nervousness, the captain could not express his meaning. Actually, what he meant was that this mysterious mechanical suit warrior seemed to be even stronger than the slightly famous Green Knight. But why was his name not on the passenger list when he checked it earlier?

He had thought that he was in a desperate situation, but Han Xiao's appearance made the captain see the light again. His heart almost jumped out of his throat.

This time, Han Xiao turned around and said, "I heard that you will pay a reward?"

Although his face was covered by the mechanical suit and his tone was very calm, for some reason, the captain felt as if he could see a face full of a cunning businessman's smile.

It was probably an illusion …

After the disappointment of the Green Knight, the captain did not dare hesitate. He could only grab onto this life-saving straw and hurriedly said, "Yes, I can pay a lot of money! I hope you can stop them! "

A notification suddenly appeared on the interface.

You have triggered the mission [Captain's Request].

Mission Introduction: The captain of Short Horn Star has decided to hire you to protect the spaceship and his safety.

Mission Requirements: Short Horn Star is successfully defended and the captain survives.

Reward: 8,000 Enas

Oh, 8,000. That's quite a lot. The purchasing power of Enas was very high. Not to mention Han Xiao's knowledge, just Kerlodd's salary as an investigator was only 4,000 Enas per year, not including the benefits of a civil servant. This guy was from the Moonlight Clan, but he could still save more than 800 Enas.

Han Xiao was very satisfied. For the same event, he could use the initiative to squeeze more profits out of different people. He was very good at using this method when he was a substitute leveler in the past, and he could achieve twice the result with half the effort. Many players also had this habit. When they knew that they were going to a place to fight monsters, they would accept all the related missions first and complete them in one go to get more rewards.
